description: This file implements the client-side React component for the 'Draft Persona' page in a Next.js project. It manages the UI for reviewing and editing a generated user persona, including profile details, skills, experiences, and navigation to the next step.

classes.name: PlaceholderAvatarIcon
classes.description: A React component rendering a placeholder SVG icon for user avatar.

classes.name: PencilIcon
classes.description: A React component rendering a pencil SVG icon.

classes.name: CheckIcon
classes.description: A React component rendering a checkmark SVG icon.

classes.name: SkillChip
classes.description: A component displaying a skill as a tag, with optional remove button in edit mode.

classes.name: TextInput
classes.description: A styled input component with label for text input fields.

classes.name: Textarea
classes.description: A styled textarea component with label for multi-line text input.

classes.name: ExperienceCard
classes.description: Displays a professional experience block with parseable role, company, and impact, editable in edit mode.

classes.name: WorkStyleInsight
classes.description: A card component illustrating inferred work style traits.

classes.name: SuccessToast
classes.description: A transient toast message component indicating successful save actions.

classes.name: DraftPersonaPage
classes.description: Main React component rendering the draft persona review/edit page with profile, skills, experiences, and navigation.

methods.name: makeDefaultSkillsFromPersona
methods.description: Returns the core skills array from the given persona object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current edits to persona state, propagates to flow state and UI, shows success message.

methods.name: confirmAndContinue
methods.description: Commits latest changes and routes to the next step in the journey (/skill-validation).

methods.name: updateIdentity
methods.description: Updates the professional identity fields within the persona.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Updates a specific career highlight/experience entry.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill if valid and not duplicate.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the skills array.

methods.name: onPickAvatar
methods.description: Handles avatar image file selection, creates object URL, updates avatar state, and triggers UI bump.
